parameters.entraSpaClientId: [if(not(empty(parameters('existingEntraSpaClientId'))), createObject('value', parameters('existingEntraSpaClientId')), createObject('value', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('{0}-rg', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'entra-app'), '2025-04-01').outputs.clientAppId.value))]
parameters.entraBackendClientId: [if(not(empty(parameters('existingEntraBackendClientId'))), createObject('value', parameters('existingEntraBackendClientId')), if(parameters('enableObo'), createObject('value', reference(extensionResourceId(format('/subscriptions/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}', subscription().subscriptionId, format('{0}-rg', parameters('environmentName'))), 'Microsoft.Resources/deployments', 'entra-app'), '2025-04-01').outputs.backendClientAppId.value), createObject('value', '')))]

containers.name: [parameters('name')]
containers.probes: [if(not(empty(parameters('healthProbePath'))), createArray(createObject('type', 'Liveness', 'httpGet', createObject('path', parameters('healthProbePath'), 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'periodSeconds', 30, 'failureThreshold', 3), createObject('type', 'Startup', 'httpGet', createObject('path', parameters('healthProbePath'), 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'periodSeconds', 10, 'failureThreshold', 30, 'initialDelaySeconds', 5)), createArray())]
